verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Smithery runs OAuth flows for downstream MCP servers using its own maintained OAuth apps, with no redirect URIs or client secrets to configure. It stores API keys and tokens in encrypted, write-only storage and refreshes tokens before expiry, setting the connection status to `auth_required` if a refresh fails. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the OAuth/vault/refresh behavior, and detail on encryption and key management for the credential store.
